Estamos em busca de umDesenvolvedor de Integração que irá atuar como responsável técnico pela camada de integração entre os sistemas SAP (ERP S/4HANA e IS-U HANA) e os sistemas legados da Light, aplicando práticas de DevSecOps para garantir entregas seguras, escaláveis, automatizadas e de alta disponibilidade. O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para aLight !


Main responsibilities

Seus desafios serão:

  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.
  • Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.
  • Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
  • Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
  • Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  • Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.

Requirements and skills

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.
  • Domínio de CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices.
  • Experiência com integração segura (HTTPS, JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).
  • Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).
  • Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).
  • Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

Additional information

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

Qualificações

  1. Experiência com projetos de CAPEX;
  2. Experiência sólida atuando em projetos industriais;
  3. Experiência com projetos de construção de indústria, planta, unidade produtiva, armazém;
  4. Experiência em empresas multinacionais globais;
  5. Excel avançado;
  6. Desejável conhecimento em SAP;
  7. Inglês avançado;
  8. Ensino superior em Engenharias e cursos correlatos.

Informações adicionais

Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.

description:
O analista de segurança com foco em gerenciamento de acessos será responsável pela implementação e gestão de soluções de controle de acesso, garantindo a segurança e a conformidade das operações de acesso aos sistemas e dados da empresa. Este profissional deve possuir sólida experiência em tecnologias de autenticação e autorização, bem como habilidades em troubleshooting e integração de sistemas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementação de Soluções de Acesso: Planejar, configurar e implementar soluções de gestão de acessos, como OIDC, SAML, OAuth, SSO, MFA e LDAP.

  • Monitoramento e Manutenção: Monitorar continuamente os sistemas de acesso e realizar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva.

  • Gestão de Identidades: Gerenciar identidades dos usuários e garantir que os acessos sejam concedidos de acordo com as políticas de segurança da empresa.

  • Integração de Sistemas: Integrar soluções de autenticação e autorização com outros sistemas corporativos.

  • Desenvolvimento de Scripts: Criar e manter scripts para automatizar processos de gerenciamento de acessos.

  • Resolução de Problemas: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas relacionados ao acesso e autenticação de usuários.

  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de TI e segurança para garantir a conformidade e a efetividade das soluções de acesso.

  • Documentação: Elaborar e manter a documentação técnica das soluções implementadas e dos processos de gestão de acessos.

Requisitos:

  • Implantação de Soluções de Gestão de Acessos: Experiência na implementação e gerenciamento de soluções de controle de acesso, como OpenID Connect (OIDC), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OAuth, Single Sign-On (SSO) e Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Capacidade de configurar e customizar estas tecnologias para se adequarem às necessidades específicas da organização.

  • LDAP e Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) para gerenciamento centralizado de autenticação e autorização. Experiência em administração de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, garantindo a integridade e segurança das informações armazenadas.

  • Infraestrutura: Familiaridade com o uso de Kubernetes para orquestração de contêineres, containers como Docker, e práticas de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible. Conhecimento em configuração e gerenciamento de redes, incluindo segurança de rede e segmentação.

  • Programação e Scripting: Noções de programação em linguagens como Python, Java ou similares. Capacidade para desenvolver scripts em Shell, Bash ou PowerShell para automatização de tarefas e processos de gerenciamento de acessos.

  • Troubleshooting: Habilidade em identificar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos relacionados ao acesso e autenticação de usuários. Capacidade de analisar logs e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento para detectar e corrigir falhas rapidamente.

  • Diferencial: Conhecimento nas soluções da Ping Identity, incluindo a implementação e gestão de produtos como PingFederate, PingAccess e PingID.

title: Team Lead - Account Management
description:
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

We’re looking for an experienced and motivated leader to join our Account Management team. You will build, mentor, and coach a team of account managers who are responsible for growing strategic merchant relationships and payments revenue. You are comfortable streamlining team operations, encouraging effective collaboration, and engaging with executives at all levels. As a critical role in the continued success in the growing Brazil operations, you will help to iterate our culture and build an amazing team environment that will create future leaders for Adyen.

What you’ll do

  • Motivate team members and encourage creativity while understanding training needs. Provide coaching in areas including but not limited to: strategic account planning, contract negotiations, product roadmap discussions, and executive engagement
  • Serve as a senior stakeholder, providing strategic and consultative advice to influence and fulfill the global payments strategy of our merchants
  • Support team in unlocking commercial opportunities, driving value to both Adyen and our clients
  • Set clear individual and team goals focused on revenue growth. Report on performance and metrics at an executive level
  • Create an inspiring and collaborative team environment with an open communication/feedback culture
  • Recruit new team members in line with the Adyen culture and required skills

Who you are

  • An energetic self-starter with a proven commercial edge, entrepreneurial track record and strong negotiation skills
  • Excited to lead and manage time-sensitive, cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial and collaborative environment
  • An excellent communicator and team player with strong management skills and technical aptitude
  • 5+ years experience in managing teams and building executive level enterprise relationships
  • 7+ years experience in account management, business development, consulting, or a related field
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Sao Paulo office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

The way we work is guided by the eight principles of the Adyen Formula. Learn more here.

To our customers we’re not just another technology provider. We’re partners in their growth. If you’re not just another sales leader, marketing professional, or support specialist then a career at Adyen is the right career for you.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Join to apply for the Engineering Manager, MAAS role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across sectors. We have a global, distributed team of over 1200 colleagues in more than 80 countries, with few office-based roles. Teams meet periodically in person at locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide a top-tier solution for building and managing private bare-metal infrastructure, offering a cloud-style on-demand API for physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We seek engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership, with deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage, and data center networking.

MAAS components cover the entire software stack: from hardware detection and provisioning to the web interface, API, and CLI. Successful engineers are fluent across these layers and can anticipate the impacts of design choices in a complex distributed system.

At Canonical, you need a solid technical background, but your primary responsibility is to lead an effective team and develop your colleagues. You will help them grow, perform outstanding work, find personal and professional satisfaction, and collaborate effectively. Technical leadership and a background in software engineering are prerequisites. You will lead, challenge, and develop engineers, influence company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work on strategy and execution. You will also collaborate with other engineering teams, such as cloud-init, LXD, and cloud services.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate leadership, deep Linux knowledge, and the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role involves:

  1. Leading a distributed engineering team in your time zone
  2. Talent development through coaching, mentoring, and career planning
  3. Managing expectations with other teams, management, and stakeholders
  4. Promoting modern software development practices
  5. Participating in code and architecture reviews
  6. Engaging with broader teams, open source community, and partners
  7. Traveling for global events (4-6 weeks per year)

We seek candidates with:

  1. Strong academic background and a degree in a technical field
  2. Confidence in communication and feedback exchange
  3. A record of exceeding expectations
  4. Leadership and mentorship skills
  5. Passion for technology and personal projects
  6. Work ethic and confidence working with motivated colleagues
  7. Excellent English communication skills
  8. Experience with Linux (Debian/Ubuntu preferred)
  9. Interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, accountability
  10. Appreciation for diversity and multicultural work environments
  11. Self-motivation and thoughtfulness
  12. Result-oriented mindset and ability to meet commitments
  13. Willingness to travel internationally twice a year
  14. Understanding of modern Linux cloud technologies (networking, storage, containers, K8s)
  15. Programming experience in Python and Go
  16. Interest in developing and growing people

Nice-to-have skills include experience with Typescript and modern web frameworks.

Role Overview

The Network Engineer is part of our 24x7 first-level support network team, focusing on network outages and related projects. You will be responsible for daily network activities, incident and change management, ensuring end-user requests are handled within SLAs. You will report to the Director, Global Networking, working onsite with a team of engineers.

Requirements

  • Advanced proficiency in English, both verbal and written (85%+).
  • 4+ years of experience in Networking (LAN/WAN & Security).
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Engineering preferred; Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP), Fortinet Certifications (FCNSA, FCNSP), and ITIL are desirable.
  • Experience with Cisco Firewalls, Routers, Switches, FortiGate UTM.
  • Deep knowledge of Cisco, FortiGate, Brocade networking products, load balancers, firewalls, routers, switches, UTMs, Wi-Fi (Cisco/Fortinet/Aruba), including maintenance and troubleshooting.
  • Expertise in networking concepts such as IPLCs, Leased Lines, MPLS, T1/T3/E1, VoIP, VPN tunnels.
  • Proficiency in configuring WAN links, VLANs, and protocols like TCP/IP, SNMP, OSPF, BGP, RIP.
  • Strong background in network security from desktop to perimeter levels.
  • Proven experience with WAN protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP) and security mechanisms (IPSec, AES, 3DES, SSL).

Responsibilities

  • Provide 24x7 Level 1 network operational support, capacity planning, infrastructure audits, security policy/VPN configuration.
  • Support troubleshooting to maintain network systems, monitor proactively to minimize downtime, and meet SLAs.
  • Conduct InfoSec activities and manage device compliance according to the InfoSec calendar.
  • Handle incident and change management processes, ensuring requests are addressed within SLAs.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and suggest enhancements to existing infrastructure.
  • Create and deliver network documentation.
  • Maintain effective communication with stakeholders, including vendors and support teams.
  • Design, implement, and manage complex network solutions to meet organizational needs.
  • Monitor and optimize network performance, addressing issues promptly.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate new technologies and ensure seamless network operations.

Location

BRA SAO PAULO Rua Tagipuru, 906 Barra Funda

English proficiency required.

Full-time

Visão geral do trabalho

Como Associado ou Consultor Associado, você apoiará a equipe sênior na realização de avaliações de risco de compliance, investigações contábeis forenses, pesquisa e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com colegas no Brasil, nos Estados Unidos e na Europa, sendo fundamentalmente responsável pelo trabalho realizado pela equipe no Brasil.

Você será responsável por tarefas relacionadas a pesquisa, investigações financeiras, litígios e questões de disputa. As responsabilidades podem incluir (mas não se limitam a):

  • Investigar e analisar registros financeiros e contábeis em apoio a investigações financeiras, como apropriação indébita de ativos, corrupção ou fraude nas demonstrações financeiras.
  • Realizar procedimentos contábeis forenses em investigações multidisciplinares que envolvem pesquisas de antecedentes, conjuntos de dados complexos e análises técnicas contábeis ou econômicas.

Acreditamos que é a conexão humana que potencializa a tecnologia, por isso, fortalecemos nossas conexões com respeito e integridade, sempre promovendo um ambiente onde temos a oportunidade de compartilhar nossas conquistas, desafios e resultados.

A crença de que a conexão humana potencializa a tecnologia

Ao longo do tempo, nós amadurecemos e ajustamos a rota, algumas vezes, para abraçarmos um crescimento constante, atendermos as necessidades dos nossos clientes e as evoluções do mercado e da sociedade.

Desde o início até aqui, mudamos como organização e como pessoas, mas sem renunciar àquilo que mais nos importa: nossa essência de ser Soul & Tech!

A NB Máquinas é uma das mais importantes indústrias do Agronegócio brasileiro e mundial. Com seu foco na linha de implementos agrícolas forrageiros, a NB se tornou um grupo com duas marcas mundialmente conhecidas: JF e Nogueira, fornecendo equipamentos para todo o território brasileiro e para mais de 50 países.

História:

Em 2013 as duas maiores e tradicionais empresas no mercado de máquinas para forragem do Brasil, a JF e a Nogueira se fundem formando um dos maiores grupos de implementos forrageiros do mundo, a NB Máquinas. Com essa união, parceiros e clientes continuam tendo a disposição os atendimentos distintos das marcas JF e Nogueira, porém ambas com muito mais força em qualidade, engenharia, desenvolvimento de produtos e soluções agrícolas.

Com uma ampla linha de produtos, nossas marcas atuam nos segmentos de distribuidores de calcário e fertilizante, plataformas recolhedoras, colhedoras de forragem, vagões misturadores, desintegradores, ensiladeiras, picadoras, vagões forrageiros, enfardadeiras, segadeiras, enleiradores e espalhadores além de embutidoras e extratoras de grãos para silo bolsa.

A soma de alto investimento em tecnologia, alinhado a uma equipe tecnicamente qualificada com profissionais comprometidos com o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, a NB Máquinas proporciona ao mercado agropecuário equipamentos de altíssima qualidade e preços competitivos, solucionando problemas do campo e cada vez mais proporcionando melhores rendimentos e facilidade para o produtor.

Nosso sucesso é o reflexo da satisfação do produtor, ao perceber que com as soluções apresentadas pelas maiores marcas do mercado forrageiro, a JF Máquinas e a Nogueira Máquinas, conseguimos aumentar a qualidade e produtividade no campo.

title: Senior Business Development Manager, Renewable and Ocean Structures (LATAM)
description:
Senior Business Development Manager, Renewable and Ocean Structures (LATAM)

Pay Competitive

Employment type: Other

Job Description

  • Lead the on-the-ground, customer-facing activities within LATAM, becoming the go-to person for our clients.
  • Attend client meetings, conferences, and lobby stakeholders as required to get the job done.
  • Be the main contributor to the development of the strategic business development plan, identifying key clients, stakeholders, and markets, and executing it.
  • Increase the exposure and market knowledge of DNV Digital Solutions products from the Renewable and Ocean Structures product portfolio to the LATAM markets, especially in the offshore wind sector.
  • Implement cross DNV BA sales strategies to provide a compelling value proposition to our clients.
  • Own the end-to-end sales process and the associated sales target.
  • Identify unmanaged strategic Key Accounts and actively manage these accounts during the early stages of their engagement with DNV Digital Solutions to build a solid relationship across the clients' organization, at decision-maker, influencer, and user levels.
  • Develop long-standing, resilient client relationships that lead to a win-win scenario for both them and DNV.
  • Mentor members of the BD team with lesser experience.
  • Be an integral part of the wider Americas Region commercial team – this is not a role for a lone wolf.

Position Qualifications

Required:

  • 10 years of industry experience in Business Development with a demonstrable track record in expanding product market penetration and achieving/surpassing realistic sales targets.
  • Minimum Bachelor's degree in engineering or business.
  • Be the tenacious hunter.
  • Extrovert, happy to present to both small client groups and large audiences.
  • Proactively build and maintain strong relationships, both externally and internally.
  • Have worked in a multi-cultural commercial environment.
  • Courage to make qualified independent decisions and move forward.
  • Solution-oriented and highly proactive.
  • Collaborative, both within the immediate team and the wider business.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to inspire people, building strong relationships.
  • Ability to travel to where the customer is – primarily within LATAM.
  • Fluent in English & Portuguese, both spoken and written.

Preferable:

  • Experience in Renewables and/or offshore energy industries within the LATAM market.
  • A professional network within the offshore and/or wind sector; this may be from a substructure design/developer/OEM/software domain.
  • Commercial experience within the technical software sector.
  • Fluent in Spanish, both spoken and written.
  • MBA degree.

Company & Business Area Description

DNV is the independent expert in assurance and risk management, operating in more than 100 countries. Through our broad experience and deep expertise, we advance safety and sustainable performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions.

We are a world-leading provider of digital solutions and software applications focused on the energy, maritime, and healthcare markets. Our solutions are used worldwide to manage risk and performance for wind turbines, electric grids, pipelines, processing plants, offshore structures, ships, and more. Supported by our domain knowledge and Veracity assurance platform, we enable companies to digitize and manage business-critical activities in a sustainable, cost-efficient, safe, and secure way.

The Product Line Renewables & Ocean Structures builds and distributes engineering software. Our mission is to empower the world’s professionals to accelerate the energy transition and sustainable use of the ocean. We aim to be the most trusted engineering and digitalization partner, bringing value through our customer experience focus. Our portfolio of software products includes a combination of successful industry favorites like Sesam, Bladed, and Nauticus Machinery, and new products aiming for hypergrowth: WindFarmer and SolarFarmer.

This Senior Business Development role will report to the Head of Business Development, Americas Region, as part of the commercial management team.

The Senior Business Development Manager will have responsibility for leading DNV’s client-facing strategy within the LATAM market, with the key focus on Brazil, to roll out a multi-year roadmap for the expansion of our market footprint within the country.

The key focus of this role is to develop DNV Digital Solutions penetration and market position within the LATAM market, primarily focusing on offshore wind. The Senior Business Development Manager will lead by example and build strong relationships, both internally with the wider regional commercial team and global functions, including the Product Line & Product Center, MarCom, Legal, and Finance, as well as interaction with clients at a senior, decision-maker level.

Equal Opportunity Statement

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity!

About the company

DNV GL is an international accredited registrar and classification society headquartered in Høvik, Norway.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. *Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Localization Project Manager for our Marketing team in Brazil!

Wellhub is seeking a L10N PM to support the localization and adaptation of marketing assets for our 10+ locales. The successful candidate will play an active role in our Localization Center of Excellence for our Marketing teams, which will secure a successful setup for global communications to consistently produce locally relevant assets that truly resonate with the different target audiences, by generating effective translations & cross-cultural adaptations thus driving revenue through improved user experience. This position will report directly to our Localization Manager and involves a strong sense of collaboration and effective communication with the rest of the Localization team, external vendors, and key stakeholders across Wellhub. This new Wellhubber will become the go-to person for successful management of any localization project, to help ensure that Wellhub consistently delivers a great native experience across its operating regions.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Manage localization and adaptation requests from Wellhub stakeholders with our team of approved translations agencies, following the approved processes and making sure projects are delivered by the agreed target date with the highest quality standards.
  • Build strong collaboration and effective communication with internal stakeholders (incl. production) to gain clear understanding of the brief, deliverables, and timeline for each project, to ensure smooth adaptation process and successful delivery of market-specific materials.
  • Demonstrate a sound understanding of Wellhub’s different target audiences (client, partners, end users), brand and style guides, as well as any language tool to achieve a consistent and locally resonant tone of voice for all comms across channels and different audiences.
  • Develop strong and effective relationships with Wellhub Localization Leads, 3rd party translation vendors, lead linguists and other local market stakeholders to deliver the right language quality per content type.
  • Support the pt-BR Localization Lead at Wellhub on the review, QA and evaluation of translations from English into pt-BR to ensure they meet the brief (format, tone of voice, language, style) and the brand and message are relevant in the local market for a high-quality localized experience.
  • Occasionally, perform brief translations when required.
  • Provide constructive feedback to the local talent when appropriate, actively participate in root-cause analysis and issue prevention and escalate quality issues to help find a way to always keep the highest quality standards.
  • Support Wellhub Localization Leads on Terminology and TM clean-up activities regularly to maintain glossaries, style guidelines, and translation memories up to date and always relevant. Also, help build and maintain a library of approved assets and l10n best practices.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Currently live in Brazil.
  • Availability to work in a hybrid model, if you reside in São Paulo (with availability to go to the office once a month).
  • Remote work for those in other Brazilian states.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Fully immersed (both linguistic and culturally) in the Brazil market reality.
  • Previous experience working as a project manager in the localization industry Ideally, experience in translating marketing-related content (incl. app localization and transcreation).
  • Knowledge of localization workflows, CAT tools, linguistic QA, and maintenance of language assets.
  • Highly organized with a quality-first approach and great attention to detail.
  • Able to perform in a dynamic environment with ongoing changes.
  • Solution-driven thinker with a proactive attitude and a quality-first approach to work.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that previous experience in localization project management and fluency in English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU (Latam)

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

Buscamos constantemente desenvolver nosso time, oferecendo oportunidades de avanço e progresso de acordo com um sólido plano de carreira. Acreditamos no potencial de cada indivíduo e investimos em seu desenvolvimento, incentivando o aprendizado contínuo e o aprimoramento profissional.

Esse profissional será responsável por gerenciar aquisições de materiais, equipamentos e serviços, negociando com fornecedores para atender às demandas específicas de obras e operações varejistas, garantindo eficiência, qualidade e controle de custos.

Formação em Administração, Logística, Economia, Ciências contábeis, Engenharia civil ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia na área de compras, especialmente em construção civil/obras de lojas em centros comerciais (shopping).

Habilidade em negociação e gestão de contratos. Conhecimento em ferramentas de ERP e Pacote Office, principalmente Excel. Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo. Senso de urgência e dono.

A Inbrasp - Indústria Brasileira de Plásticos possui mais de 10 anos de atividades com foco no fornecimento de peças plásticas automotivas para os segmentos agroindustrial, movimentação de terra, automobilístico, caminhões e ônibus.

Atualmente, além da Caio, empresa fabricante de ônibus, possui clientes do setor automotivo com atuação global. Por isso, a empresa conquista ano a ano um patamar de destaque com a conquista de importantes premiações de qualidade e excelência.

Possui três unidades fabris: Matriz Botucatu, localizada próxima a outras empresas do Grupo Caio; Filial Botucatu, sediada no Distrito Industrial; e Filial Betim, em Minas Gerais.

Colaboradores da Inbrasp podem usufruir de inúmeros benefícios, como refeitório, atendimento médico/ambulatorial, serviço social, ônibus para transporte e estrutura de lazer (sala de TV, sala de jogos, bancos, espreguiçadeiras).

A empresa também conta com o PHE - Programa de Humanização da Empresa, que auxilia os colaboradores e a sociedade em diversas áreas, formado por 17 frentes: PHE Antiestresse, Bem-Estar, Chefia, Cidadão Juvenil, Educação, Meio Ambiente, Missões, Mulher, Orçamento Familiar, Pró-Nutri, Pró-Vida, Qualificando a mão de obra, Respire bem, Solidário, Acolhimento I (Afastados e INSS) e Acolhimento II (Gestantes) e Valorização Profissional.

Benefícios adicionais incluem auxílio funeral, farmácia, banco (empréstimo consignado), estudantil (escolas, cursos superiores, cursos de idiomas), material escolar, médico, odontológico, óticas e Sesi.

Venha fazer parte de um ambiente de constante crescimento e oportunidades.

Inspecionar equipamentos e acompanhar consertos, efetuando estudos e recomendações específicas. O Grupo Caio é formado por empresas que oferecem soluções inovadoras em mobilidade, tendo como empresa-mãe a Caio, uma das maiores fabricantes de ônibus urbanos do mundo, com presença em mais de 50 países e 76 anos de história.

Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. That’s why we built the most complete cloud analytics and data platform for AI. What You’ll Do

The Senior Data Scientist (pre-sales) is an experienced and expert Data Scientist, able to provide industry thought-leadership on Analytics and its application across industries and across use-cases. The Senior Data Scientist supports the account team in framing business problems and in identifying analytic solutions that leverage Teradata technology and that are disruptive, innovative - and above all, practical. An articulate and compelling communicator, the Senior Data Scientist establishes our position as an important partner for advanced analytics with customers and prospects and is a trusted advisor to executives, senior managers and fellow data scientists alike across a range of target accounts. They are also a hands-on practitioner who is ready, willing and able to roll-up her sleeves and to deliver POC and short-term pre-sales engagements. The Senior Data Scientist has an excellent theoretical and practical understanding of statistics and machine learning and has a strong track record of applying this understanding at scale to drive business benefit. They are insanely curious and is a natural problem-solver and able to effectively promote Teradata technology and solutions to our customers.

Who You’ll Work With

The successful candidate will work with other expert team members to:

  1. Provide pre-sales support at an executive level to the Teradata account teams, helping them to position and sell complex Analytic solutions that drive sales of Teradata software.
  2. Provide strategic pre-sales consulting to executives and senior managers in our target market.
  3. Support the delivery of PoC and PoV projects that demonstrate the viability and applicability of Analytic use-cases and the superiority of Teradata solutions and services.
  4. Work with the extended Account team, and Sales Analytics Specialists to develop new Analytic propositions that are aligned with industry trends and customer requirements.

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

  1. A degree level qualification (preferably Masters or PHD) in Statistics, Data Science, the physical or biological sciences or a related discipline.
  2. Have proven hands-on experience of complex analytics at scale for example in the areas of IoT and sensor data.
  3. Understand the PMML and ONNX model portability standards.
  4. Have experience with Teradata partner’s analytical products, Cloud Service providers such as AzureML and Sagemaker and partner products such as Dataiku and H2O.
  5. Have strong hands-on programming skills in at least one major analytic programming language and/or tool in addition to SQL.

What You’ll Bring

  1. An expertise in Data Science with a strong theoretical grounding in statistics, advanced analytics, and machine learning and at least 5 years real-world experience in the application of advanced analytics.
  2. A passion about knowledge sharing and demonstrate a commitment to continuous professional development.
  3. A belief in Teradata's Analytic solutions and services and be a commitment to working with the product, engineering, and consulting teams to ensure that they continue to lead the market.
  4. An ability to turn complex technical subject matter into relatable easy to digest and understand content for senior audiences.

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. title: ENCARREGADO INSTRUMENTAÇÃO
description:
Job description

Responsável pelos processos de Instrumentação, tanto nos aspectos técnicos e administrativos, acompanhando as operações em campo, coordenando e capacitando a equipe nas atividades de instalação e manutenção do setor, com o objetivo de atingir os resultados do negócio e formação de time.


Main responsibilities

  1. Responder pelos processos de Instrumentação, tanto nos aspectos técnicos quanto administrativos, acompanhando as operações em campo, coordenando e capacitando a equipe nas atividades do setor, com o objetivo de atingir os resultados do negócio;
  2. Receber e/ou participar da definição das metas desdobradas das diretrizes da companhia, cuidando da comunicação e envolvimento da equipe e participar ativamente do desenvolvimento dos planos de ação, visando o atendimento dos resultados necessários;
  3. Avaliar os indicadores da área, medindo sua aderência aos quesitos de qualidade, custo, produtividade e segurança; Identificar desvios e propor ações corretivas para melhoria dos resultados. Realizar análises considerando recursos (tais como materiais, financeiros, matéria prima, mão-de-obra), métodos de trabalho e equipamentos necessários para a realização das metas estabelecidas;
  4. Desenvolver planos prazo para a consecução dos processos sob sua responsabilidade em linha com a missão, aspiração e valores da companhia;
  5. Auxiliar o supervisor na identificação de investimentos em tecnologia, equipamentos e projetos necessários para adequação legal, ou que venham alavancar os resultados da empresa;
  6. Atender às legislações vigentes relativas à sua área de trabalho, minimizando e/ ou eliminando os eventuais passivos, tomando as ações necessárias para prevenir os problemas;
  7. Coordenar o setor de instrumentação, resolvendo os problemas relacionados aos processos produtivos, orientando a equipe quanto às providências a serem tomadas a fim de manter a adequação do processo e garantir a eficiência produtiva e a qualidade do produto desejada;
  8. Coordenar o setor de instrumentação nas manutenções corretivas, preventivas e preditivas de motores elétricos, instrumentos, válvulas de controle, transmissores, equipamentos e sistemas de automação, aparelhos de ar-condicionado etc., definindo prioridades, distribuindo as atividades conforme a especialidade das mesmas, orientando a equipe nos trabalhos realizados e acompanhando a execução dos mesmos, com intuito de assegurar a qualidade e o cumprimento de prazos;
  9. Supervisiona a execução de projetos internos ou fornecidos por terceiros para ampliação da indústria, através de suporte técnico do supervisor, verificando o material necessário para os trabalhos e as especificações dos mesmos, decidindo o melhor modo de condução dos projetos e distribuindo as atividades aos colaboradores responsáveis;
  10. Elabora e acompanha cronograma de execução dos projetos, direcionando prioridades e definindo atividades especiais para que os projetos sejam cumpridos dentro das especificações técnicas adequadas e dentro do prazo necessário para o trabalho;
  11. Elabora procedimentos operacionais e de manutenção da área de instrumentação;
  12. Participar e/ou elaborar revisões periódicas dos planos e procedimentos de manutenção da área de Instrumentação.
  13. Solicita serviços de instrumentação para prestadores de serviços, acompanhando a execução dos trabalhos, a qualidade e cronograma para que os setores sejam entregues dentro do custo, tempo e qualidade;
  14. Controla, por meio de relatórios, as horas gastas por cada colaborador na instalação ou manutenção dos equipamentos visando controlar os custos do setor;
  15. Elaborar o cronograma de manutenção de entressafra, bem como o levantamento dos materiais necessários para a execução das atividades, realizando o acompanhamento de sua execução, gerando planos de ações, se necessário, em busca do atendimento do planejamento inicial de custo, prazo e qualidade;
  16. Acompanhar e capacitar membros do time quanto a operação de turbogeradores;
  17. Garantir à área de Instrumentação, as ferramentas necessárias para a execução das atividades, providenciando a compra, reposição ou manutenção das ferramentas das duas áreas;
  18. Atuar, durante a entressafra, na manutenção geral da área, coordenando a atuação dos profissionais de manutenção de acordo com as ordens de serviço e com as orientações do supervisor, orientando às equipes nas atividades necessárias, visando o cumprimento do custo, prazo e qualidade de execução das atividades;
  19. Conduzir o processo em situações de emergência e atuar na prevenção e controle de falhas, ocorrências, desvios e não conformidades do setor;
  20. Avaliar os processos sob sua gestão e o trabalho de seus subordinados de modo crítico, cuidando da padronização e melhoria dos processos, sempre com o foco em resultados, redução de custos e responsabilidade social e ambiental.
  21. Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente do trabalho, estabelecidos pela organização, bem como, utilizar constantemente todos os EPIs de uso obrigatório no desenvolvimento das atividades do cargo e do setor. Tendo a responsabilidade de informar ao seu superior imediato qualquer atividade que apresente risco a sua saúde ou dos demais colegas de trabalho;
  22. Exercer as atividades em comum acordo com os valores, políticas, diretrizes, procedimentos e processos da empresa, sempre focando nas metas organizacionais, e mantendo sigilo e protegendo as informações da companhia;
  23. Manter a disciplina no programa 5S, objetivando um trabalho seguro por meio da manutenção da organização, padronização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho;
  24. Zelar pelas propriedades da empresa sob sua responsabilidade, informando ao superior imediato qualquer problema ou avaria detectada.

Requirements and skills

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas afins;

Additional information

Benefícios: Vale Alimentação; Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Orienteme; Edupass; Gympass; PPR; Refeição no local; Transporte gratuito.

Pesquisador I (Analista de Negócio/Inteligência Estratégica) – RP 14922

Sistema Fiep também é sinônimo de Inovação e Tecnologia. Levamos soluções sobre necessidades atuais e futuras, proporcionando ações de estímulo ao pensamento inovador. Para você que deseja contribuir com o nosso propósito, de transformar o Paraná no melhor lugar para a indústria no Brasil, esta vaga pode ser sua!

Qual é a posição?

Pesquisador I (Analista de Negócio/Inteligência Estratégica) – RP 14922 – Senai Campus da Indústria – Curitiba/PR

Quais são os desafios e as principais responsabilidades?

Este profissional irá oferecer apoio estratégico de alto impacto, utilizando dados e análises avançadas como suporte à tomada de decisão da alta gestão. Implementar soluções de gestão e fortalecimento do portfólio de serviços do Senai. Desenvolver mecanismos de acompanhamento de indicadores com objetivo de assegurar o alinhamento estratégico dos negócios.

  • Liderar projetos complexos de inteligência estratégica, desde a concepção até a implementação, com foco em melhorar a eficiência e posicionamento institucional com orientação à competitividade da indústria.
  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos, cenários e relatórios interativos e informacionais para suporte à tomada de decisões estratégicas, apontar oportunidades e mitigar riscos.
  • Construir soluções inovadoras para desafios estratégicos, como fortalecimento industrial paranaense por meio das soluções ofertadas pelo Senai, fortalecimento do portfólio orientado ao desenvolvimento industrial do estado e otimização de processos;
  • Mapear tendências de mercado e oportunidades de negócios com foco em fortalecer o posicionamento do Senai junto às indústrias do Paraná;
  • Identificar soluções em temas de defesa de interesses do Senai, como articulações com stakeholders, parcerias públicas e privadas, identificação de fomentos e captação de recursos.

Requisitos

Gostou? Então verifique se você possui os requisitos abaixo:

  • Ensino Superior completo. Desejável nas áreas Administração, Economia, Engenharia, estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência avançada com métodos quantitativos e qualitativos de pesquisas de mercado, estatísticas, tratamento de bases de dados;
  • Experiência com oratória e mediação de atividades em grupo (oficinas, condução de reuniões com stakeholders estratégicos, workshops, apresentações de estudos e pesquisas);
  • Experiência com Gestão de projetos e metodologias ágeis;
  • Desejável Especialização / Pós-graduação completa em Gestão Estratégica, Marketing, Inteligência de Mercado, Gestão de Projetos, Análise de dados ou áreas afins.
  • Desejável Certificações em Project Management Professional (PMP), metodologias ágeis, análise de dados e design de serviços são diferenciais.
  • Desejável inglês intermediário;
  • Desejável pacote office avançado (Pacote Office: Word, Power Point, Excel, Outlook);
  • Desejável conhecimento avançado com as ferramentas de Análise de dados (ferramentas de BI, linguagem de programação, etc);
  • Candidatos Internos, atender aos critérios de elegibilidade NG 0077 (4.5.4).

Num mercado bastante concentrado e dominado por grandes bancos, como o brasileiro, o potencial para essa transformação é imenso. A Galapagos Capital quer liderar esse processo. Desse jeito, ajudamos empresas e pessoas a terem acesso a crédito de forma competitiva e transformamos esses créditos em soluções de investimento -tudo dentro de casa.

A evolução na forma de fazer Banking - Somos mais eficientes, mais ágeis e, principalmente, oferecemos resultados muito melhores para nossos clientes. É para isso que a Galapagos nasceu: para ajudar o mercado financeiro a evoluir, alcançando seu potencial e beneficiando milhões de brasileiros.

title: Gerente de vendas - Loja Carmen Steffens - Vitoria Shopping - ES
description:
Quem somos

MISSÃO

A Carmen Steffens nasceu com o objetivo de oferecer às suas clientes produtos exclusivos, de alta qualidade, evidenciando o conceito de moda feminina no Brasil e no mundo.

VISÃO

A Carmen Steffens preocupa-se com a satisfação de cada cliente que busca itens únicos. Assim, lança peças exclusivas, 100% delas em fábrica própria, garantindo beleza, qualidade e conforto para seus consumidores.

VALORES

A Carmen Steffens valoriza e respeita o trabalho dos seus colaboradores, que fazem parte do dia a dia da marca. Na empresa, o convívio em harmonia e o bem-estar entre as pessoas estão refletidos nos produtos criativos da marca.

Com seu DNA de luxo e exclusividade, a Carmen Steffens se tornou uma das grifes mais conceituadas do Hemisfério Sul e uma referência no mundo da moda.

A grife, batizada com o nome da mãe do economista Mario Spaniol, nasceu na cidade de Franca, interior de São Paulo, em 1993, e atualmente conta com 560 lojas em 19 países.

A infraestrutura de produção da Carmen Steffens atende a todos os mercados em que a empresa está presente, iniciando pelo couro, em curtume próprio, passando por diversas etapas que incluem solados, saltos, palmilhas, até que o sapato, bolsa ou vestuário estejam prontos.

Além dos tradicionais sapatos e bolsas reconhecidos da grife, a marca também passou a produzir roupas, com uma fábrica em Criciúma, Santa Catarina, polo têxtil nacional, e lançou inúmeras lojas com seu novo conceito Maison.

A marca lança anualmente dez coleções e conta com estrelas internacionalmente reconhecidas, como a top brasileira Alessandra Ambrósio, para protagonizar suas campanhas.

No portfólio de marcas da grife, também encontra-se a linha masculina, Raphael Steffens, e a CS Club, lançada em 2015 e que já possui mais de 100 lojas no Brasil.

Eleita a melhor franquia de moda do Brasil em 2006 pela Fundação Getúlio Vargas, a Carmen Steffens é líder no mercado nacional e construiu uma sólida reputação global, graças à qualidade e design de seus produtos e a um modelo de negócios altamente rentável.

Principais Responsabilidades

  1. Gerenciar, orientar e motivar a equipe de vendas;
  2. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPI’s) e propor ações corretivas;
  3. Realizar treinamentos e desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe;
  4. Garantir a correta execução das estratégias comerciais no ponto de venda;
  5. Atuar diretamente com clientes, promovendo ações que impulsionam nosso relacionamento, eventos bem elaborados e networking;
  6. Realizar acompanhamento com os vendedores;
  7. Apoiar nas negociações comerciais e fechamento de vendas;
  8. Analisar a performance da equipe e elaborar planos de ação;
  9. Reportar resultados e desafios à supervisão e à diretoria comercial;
  10. Promover a cultura da empresa e garantir o cumprimento das políticas internas.

Requisitos

  • Residir no Estado do Espírito Santo (Vitória ou Vila Velha - ES);
  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência prévia em liderança de equipes;
  • Forte conhecimento em técnicas de vendas e negociação;
  • Habilidade analítica para interpretação de relatórios de desempenho;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e perfil mão na massa;
  • Domínio de plataformas digitais e do ambiente digital.

Salário fixo + comissão

CLT - Nível Pleno.

ESSA É UMA VAGA PRESENCIAL (NÃO-REMOTA) E EXIGE PROFICIÊNCIA EM INGLÊS

Our Game QA Testers are gaming experts who test video games during the initial development stage. Their job is to detect any bugs or glitches in the game before it goes on sale. They are required to complete all stages of a game, explore every map and level, focusing on identifying technical issues within a game, such as glitches, bugs, and inconsistencies.

To be one of our Game QA Testers, you should have in-depth knowledge of video game playthrough, have a real passion for gaming, and a good eye for detail. As a first step in the video game industry, you will be testing different titles on a variety of platforms.

Are you a gamer at heart? Are you a team player and is motivated to learn and grow? This is your opportunity to join the world leading company in video-games testing and contribute to the development lifecycle of some of the most popular games in the world!

No previous experience needed! We will help you learn the basic responsibilities of game testing, including playing multiple AAA games, detecting bugs and glitches, and recommending improvements. Our global team perform functionality and compliance checks on a range of yet-to-be-released games for a variety of platforms including PC, Xbox One, PS5, Switch, VR and mobile and tablet devices.

What you will be doing:

  • Testing games and software to find bugs and following test plans and checklists set by Test Leads to ensure the game functions correctly.
  • Report bugs into tracking database and re-test bugs once they’re fixed by developers by collaborating with colleagues, Senior Testers and Test Leads.
  • Report all glitches and bugs on the platform.
  • Communicating any issues to your Lead and recommending game additions or modifications.
  • Working as part of a global Games QA squad.
  • To love videogames !
  • Advanced proficiency in English (able to read, write, listen and speak ).
  • Availability to work from 10h00 to 19h00 (with 1 hour for lunch), from Mondays to Fridays.

  • Transportation allowance + Meal Voucher + Medical Assistance + Life Insurance + Private Pension
  • Dynamic, multicultural and fun environment.
  • You will be working for the world's leading provider of game services.
  • A supportive community inclusive of LGBTQ+, and any age, ethnicity, religion, or disability.
  • We care about the wellbeing of our employees and have a dedicated employee wellbeing program.
  • We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.

Who are we?

Side (formally known as PTW)is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in Japan in 1994, Side has grown to become a global force in the video game industry, with over 40 studios in 15 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include codev, art production, localization, audio production, quality assurance, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets.

title: Project Controller
description:
Advert
Benthic, part of Acteon Group, is a complete end-to-end provider of geotechnical consulting, engineering, design, and data acquisition services. We strive to deliver the highest standard of service safely, efficiently, and to our client's full satisfaction. Our vision is to be globally recognized as a provider of best-in-class geotechnical survey and geo-consulting services, admired for our professionalism and ability to create value for all stakeholders.


Benthic is looking to add a highly diligent and meticulous Project Controller to the team. The Project Controller is primarily responsible for working as a support point for the Operational, Financial and Sales teams to ensure financial control over project costs are maintained throughout the execution, from set-up to close-out, of each project. The Project Controller will work with all Operational functions to ensure adequate tracking of project revenues through the monitoring of the project budget or contracts as the scope of work progresses.


The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.


Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.


Duties

  1. Responsible for financial control of projects including actuals of cost and revenues as well as its monthly forecast, annual budget and for the project cash flow.
  2. Project Accounting analysis & reconciliation.
  3. Responsible for the monthly revenue and cost accruals related to project work.
  4. Controls the projects billings and accounts receivables.
  5. Engage directly with sales and operations to manage project tracking at a project level and aggregate level to ensure proper costing and forecasting of activity (including revenue, costs, and cash).
  6. Advise on any potential issues relating to project cost or revenue, specifically, any significant deviations from forecast or budget.
  7. Assist project teams to ensure variation control, specifically, ensuring that costs associated with additional work that is not part of our contract is being captured and invoiced accordingly.
  8. Liaise with project teams to ensure all sales invoices are raised and payments expedited in a timely manner.
  9. Support the Project Manager with the PMR preparation and report.
  10. Supports the tender manager on financial aspects. Provides input to negotiations on commercial issues. Provides input in local risk review process.
  11. Preparation of business cases and financial feasibility analysis when required.
  12. Work with Financial Manager to ensure revenue forecasts and costing is in place to properly input forecasts into the corporate projections’ files.
  13. Support the Finance team with the closing month process and in assisting with audits.
  14. Maintain accurate files in accordance with agreed standard file structure to ensure ongoing data integrity and compliance.
  15. Assist to ensure complete audits of project costs are actioned as required.
  16. Interface with the finance team at all stages of the project to ensure consistency of information with reporting costs to complete and cash flow forecast.
  17. Adhere strictly to the Company’s policies including, but not limited to, anti-bribery and Foreign Corrupt Practice.

Required

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; Business administration or Economy.
  2. 5 years’ experience as Project Controller in Oil & Gas industry for EPCI contracts.
  3. Excellent knowledge of accounting and financial rules and processes.
  4. Knowledge in IFRS 15 and POC methodology and application.
  5. Strong MS Excel skills.
  6. Attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
  7. Trustworthy and Ethical.
  8. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  9. Advanced level in English, both written and spoken.
  10. Must be team-oriented, possess a positive attitude and work well with others.
  11. Ability to competently and professionally present financial reports in meetings with stakeholders, as well as identify and mitigate operational concerns.
  12. Ability to work both independently and within teams.

title: Alliances Field Engineer
description:
1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Alliances Field Engineer to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location : This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
  • Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
  • Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
  • Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
  • Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
  • Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
  • Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
  • Fluent written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
  • Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
  • Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
  • Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Devops Engineer role at Rain .

About Rain

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We have raised nearly $400M in funding, including the largest Series A in fintech history, and recently closed our Series B to support our next phase of growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team. This role involves designing, deploying, and managing scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications. You will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment within our microservices architecture. If you excel in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources for high availability and scalability.
  2. Microservices Deployment: Build and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes with Helm. Support and enhance microservices developed in Go (Golang).
  3. CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and maintain robust pipelines in GitLab CI/CD for seamless build, test, and deployment workflows. Optimize for performance, reliability, and security.
  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and proactively resolve bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Work with development and QA teams to manage application lifecycle. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience

  1. Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deployment and scaling.
  2. Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  3. Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  4. Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  5. Experience with monitoring tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  6. Familiarity with Helm and secure deployment practices.
  7. Public Cloud certifications in AWS and/or Kubernetes are a plus.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Are you a hands-on technology enthusiast who loves coding, designing, and building new things, and wants to learn new Cloud skills? Do you want to build solutions that scale? We need engineers with the right mix of knowledge and skills inpublic cloud, Windows and Linux server administration and software development who want to build and operate our services at scale.

Thomson Reuters Platform Engineering organization partners with cloud and SaaS providers around the globe to provide world-class computing platforms to our application teams. We are seeking candidates to expand and mature our capabilities in Amazon, Azure, Oracle, and Google clouds, while maintaining a stable and secure ecosystem inside our own hosting centers.

About the team:

We are software and systems engineers who are responsible for ensuring the global availability of our platforms and services. We strive to develop and operate services that focus on a collaboration with public cloud partners and SaaS providers and operate them using the best of ITIL.

We place a high degree of trust and responsibility in the hands of our engineers and expect them to deliver. We recognize that everyone can’t be a superstar in every area, so we are looking for people who have the required skills now and want to continue to learn.

In return, we ensure every individual has interesting problems to investigate, the resources they need, and opportunities to improve their skills and advance their careers.

Our culture:

  • Wepartner Management acrossTR.
  • Wecreate the right framework that enables every individual to contribute to solving problems for the team and the organization.
  • We seek to eliminate manual and repetitive by design when it is cost effective.
  • We reuse whenever possible, exploiting open-source tools, cloud technology and build new tools when required.
  • Wevalue interpersonal aptitude, innovative thinking and learning ability above proficiency with a specific toolset
    .

About You:

In this opportunity as a Senior Cloud Engineer, you:

  • Have strong technical skills: You easily learn new technologies. You are curious and creative and can adapt to existing tech and envision new ways of doing things.
  • You focus on continuous improvement and technical standards: You drive improvements in productivity. You want to learn and develop architectures for new services, prepare technical specifications and set industry best practices.
  • You can code: You are comfortable programming in at least one high-level language such as Python, PowerShell, or Ruby and are willing to learn more!
  • You are an effective communicator: You can demonstrate effective communication skills to clearly state priorities and provide direction. You can present complex technical information in clear and easy to understand manner to various audiences.
  • You have cloud experience: You have work in the cloud and have experience in at least one of the Big Two clouds (Amazon, Azure) and understand how to leverage cloud technologies to manage systems and infrastructure.
  • You are a problem solver: You apply an evidence-based approach to solving service problems in real time to provide the fastest path to recovery.

About the role:

  • We use agile/lean development frameworks likeScrum to manage our work.
  • We are driven by quality, not quantity and ensure our services are robust and resilient.
  • We automate as much as we can using a heavy integration of pipelines, micro-services, and 3rd party SaaS services and custom software when appropriate.
  • We produce a lot of data and work with our analysts to make sense of it.We try to identify trends and find potential issues before they cause problems.
  • We understand cloud technologies and platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.We use their APIs and configuration tools.

Required Skills

You are a fit for the role of Senior Cloud Engineer if you have:

  • 4+ years progressive technology experience and a drive to build a career working on cloud infrastructure and automation.
  • Bachelor of Computer Science or related field; or equivalent level of experience.
  • Strong Windows or Linux server administration skills.
  • Experience designing and implementing cloud infrastructure in either of the Big Two clouds: AWS or Azure.Relevant experience includes:
    • PipeLines: CodeBuilder, Image Builder, GitHub Actions, etc.
    • EC2/Azure VM
    • S3/Azure Artifacts
    • Security models, roles, and/or policies
  • Experience writing and maintaining cloud automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using technologies such as Terraform, BICEP, or CloudFormation.
  • Source Code Management skills using Git (GitHub experience is a plus)
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills, including the ability to communicate large, complex designs in easy terms.

Desired Skills

  • Experience with FedRAMP, FIPS and other federal security controls.
  • Experience building Machine Images in the cloud.
  • A solid understanding of TCP/IP networking.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker, ECS/EKS, or AKS
  • Experience with OS patch management and patch automation.

You will be responsible for the technical aspects of the pre-sales process, ensuring seamless integration and alignment of our products with customer needs, while representing Amagi’s innovative broadcast solutions in the market.

Quem somos?

Somos uma empresa de produtos de tecnologia corporativa. Temos mais de 15 anos de história e estamos só no começo! Nice-to-Have Skills:

ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
Demonstrates leadership in the areas of safety and environment. This requires observing and enforcing safety rules and practices, encouraging safe work behaviors, and promptly correcting conditions and unsafe behavior, which may lead to accidents.
Continually endorse the Quality & Food Safety Policies, assure conformance to all requirements of the Quality & Food Safety Management Systems, & take action to properly report failures of these systems to site management.

Essential Functions

  • Communicate HSE incidents and corrective actions in a timely, thorough, and effective manner.
  • Partner with Human Resources to monitor the status of all open Workers Compensation claims and coordinate activities to minimize lost and/or restricted work days.
  • Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) original file and index by entering new and updating SDS when received, copying and distribution of SDS for all departments involved, filing in master book in front offices.
Marginal Functions
  • Writes work orders as necessary.
  • Provides technical information on facility safety and government regulations as they pertain to health and safety to the Rochester site.
  • Recommends policies and procedures ensuring all employees maintain safety and regulatory compliance.
  • Responsible for knowledge and implementation of all upcoming Federal and State legislation relative to safety and ensures informing the various departments of upcoming changes.
  • Attends and participates in the bi-weekly managers operations meeting and daily stand-up meetings.

EDUCATION:Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Safety, Industrial or Environmental Engineering.
EXPERIENCE:
3-5 years experience working in a manufacturing facility preferably in a food manufacturing environment.
In-depth knowledge of HSE regulations, including OSHA, EPA and local requirements.
Knowledge and experience with relevant consensus standards such as NFPA and ANSI, and systems such as ISO 14001.

  • O principal objetivo desta posição é liderar a Área de Frota para garantir o melhor nível de serviço, equilibrando recursos humanos e ativos da frota própria da PepsiCo Alimentos, com as seguintes características (conflitantes entre si):
